cities.name: Sydney, Australia
cities.description: A harbour city built around an opera house and a bridge, with ocean beaches thirty minutes from the centre. Downside: hotel prices in December are brutal.

cities.name: Melbourne, Australia
cities.description: Laneway coffee, street art and the best food per square kilometre in the country. Downside: four seasons in one afternoon, every afternoon.

cities.name: Tokyo, Japan
cities.description: Thirteen million people and somehow it still runs on time. Go for the neighbourhoods, not the landmarks. Downside: you will walk twenty kilometres a day.

cities.name: Kyoto, Japan
cities.description: Wooden houses, moss gardens and more than a thousand temples. Downside: the famous spots are shoulder to shoulder between ten and four.

cities.name: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
cities.description: Mountains falling straight into the Atlantic, and a city that treats the beach as a public square. Downside: plan your neighbourhoods carefully after dark.

cities.name: Sao Paulo, Brazil
cities.description: The cultural engine of South America: galleries, live music and a Japanese quarter worth a whole day. Downside: traffic can eat two hours of it.

temples.name: Angkor Wat, Cambodia
temples.description: The largest religious monument on earth, best seen at sunrise from the northern reflecting pool. Downside: the 5 a.m. start is not optional.

temples.name: Kiyomizu-dera, Japan
temples.description: A wooden hall on stilts above the Kyoto hillside, spectacular in autumn. Downside: the approach street is a tourist funnel, so arrive before eight.

temples.name: Borobudur, Indonesia
temples.description: A ninth-century Buddhist mandala in stone, ringed by volcanoes and morning mist. Downside: access to the upper terraces is limited and must be booked.

beaches.name: Bora Bora, French Polynesia
beaches.description: A turquoise lagoon around a volcanic peak, with water clear enough to read a map through. Downside: it is the most expensive night of the trip.

beaches.name: Copacabana Beach, Brazil
beaches.description: Four kilometres of sand that works as Rio's living room, from sunrise swimmers to late football. Downside: it is a city beach, so watch your bag.

beaches.name: Waikiki Beach, Hawaii
beaches.description: Gentle rolling surf under Diamond Head, and the friendliest place in the world to stand on a board for the first time. Downside: it is never empty.
